_comment: HOLLOWSONG - an echo canyon. A walk-and-call world (no goal, no puzzle): banded red cliffs, wind-carved arches and a dry riverbed at sunset, where every sound comes back and the echoes show as soft ripples (HowlDirector / EchoRipples). Eight regions: Sundown Landing (where you arrive), Red Stair, Dry Run, Whisper Walls, the Choir, Hoodoo Flats, the Hush and Cottonwood Bend. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own sun-baked ground + litter atlas, junipers/sage/cottonwoods, cliffs (buildings with view 'cliff': CliffView) and arches (a cliff with an 'arch' opening and 'solid_rects' for its legs). Its secret is a hidden cave that answers wrong: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'echo'). Generated by tools/gen_hollowsong_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_hollowsong.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Warm stone, long shadows, and a wind that remembers. This canyon gives back everything you say to it. A wolf's voice carries furthest.

props.label: an old fire ring
props.lore: A ring of stones round old ashes, one ember still red. Whoever sat here talked to the canyon for a long while; the ash is all in a neat line, as if it had been listening too.

props.label: a notice board
props.lore: A sun-bleached notice board. 'WELCOME TO HOLLOWSONG. This canyon keeps everything you say to it, and gives it back a little late. Call out and see. A companion in a wolf's shape has the voice for it: tap the little chip at the bottom right, choose Wolf, then Howl.'

props.label: the echo-keeper's board
props.lore: The echo-keeper's notes, in pencil: 'The walls answer from where they stand. Watch the ripples come home. But one voice comes back from where there is NO wall, violet and late, and it has a place of its own. Stand somewhere else and call again; where the two lines cross is where it lives.'

props.label: a weathered board
props.lore: THE HUSH. 'Past here the cliffs lean close. Voices go in. Something answers more slowly than it should, and from the wrong side of the rock.'

props.label: a little cairn
props.lore: Seven stones, each smaller than the last. Travellers leave one for every echo they were sure they heard.

props.label: a cairn
props.lore: A cairn with a feather pushed in the top. The wind turns the feather, and the feather seems to turn the wind.

props.label: a dry log
props.lore: A silver-grey log, bleached smooth. It is hollow, and if you put your ear to one end you hear the canyon's own low note, like blowing across a bottle.

props.label: a round red boulder
props.lore: A red boulder with a cream stripe through it, warm all the way through. A lizard has been sunning on it, and has left, offended.

props.label: a hoodoo
props.lore: A tall stone column with a cap like a hat. It leans a little toward the wall behind it, the way you lean toward someone telling a secret.

props.label: a cairn in the Choir
props.lore: A cairn at the exact spot where, the keeper's board says, every wall in the Choir answers at once. You say 'hello' very quietly. The canyon says it back, from four sides.

props.label: a hoodoo
props.lore: A banded pillar, red and cream and red again. It is a hundred thousand years of rivers, stacked, and it is currently being used as a perch by a very small bird.

props.label: a hoodoo
props.lore: One of the tall ones. The wind has worn a hole through its middle, and it hums when the breeze is right. Right now it is.

props.label: a driftwood log
props.lore: The river left this here, the last time there was one. It is carried further than any tree grows: stripped, and polished, and entirely at peace with having been so far.

props.label: a flowering yucca
props.lore: A yucca in bloom, a tall white stalk of bells. Moths come for it at night. By day it just stands there looking proud of itself.

props.label: a cairn by the slot
props.lore: A cairn at the slot's mouth. The stones are all slightly warm, and slightly out of tune with each other, and you decide not to ask.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Hollowsong'). reveal.type 'echo': in wolf form the companion howls on command; EchoField bounces the howl off the authored 'walls' and draws the returning ripples. One answer comes late and violet from reveal.cave.origin, where there is no wall. Walking within reveal_radius of cave.mouth opens the crack in the cliff and shows the answering stone. The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A bowl of smooth red stone, cool as a spring. When you lean close it says your own breath back to you a beat late, as though it were learning how. Your companion's ears go up.

lines.arrive: Warm stone, long shadows, and a wind that remembers. This canyon gives back everything you say to it. A wolf's voice carries furthest.
lines.not_wolf: Your companion tries, but only a thin little sound comes out. A wolf's voice would carry down this canyon.
lines.first_echo: The canyon takes the call and gives it back, wall by wall. Watch the ripples come home.
lines.silence: Nothing comes back. There is too much open air here. Try nearer the cliffs.
lines.wrong: One of those came back violet, and late, from where there is no wall at all. Stand somewhere else and call again: where the two lines cross is where it lives.
lines.notice: Your companion has stopped, staring at a shadow in the cliff.
lines.reveal: The cliff has a crack in it, wider than you thought. A cool breath comes out, and something in there is answering your footsteps.
lines.cooldown: The canyon is still giving the last one back.

reveal.reveal_line: The cliff has a crack in it, wider than you thought. A cool breath comes out, and something in there is answering your footsteps.

secret.found_line: It had been answering you all along, a little late and from the wrong side of the rock. The canyon was never empty; it was only listening.

keepsake.label: a stone bowl that answers
keepsake.line: A small red bowl. Speak into it and it answers a beat late, in a voice a little like yours. Your companion puts its head on one side.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
